widget.name: Mendix React Trend
widget.description: Mendix React Trend Pluggable Widget. Based on https://github.com/unsplash/react-trend.

property.caption: Trend list
property.description: The list of objects that hold the points of the line, in order.

property.caption: Trend value
property.description: The value of each point. Empty values are skipped. At least two points are needed to draw a line.

property.caption: Line color
property.description: Solid color of the line (any CSS color, for example #007693, rgb(0, 118, 147) or var(--brand-primary)). Leave empty to use the current text color. Ignored when a gradient is set.

property.caption: Gradient
property.description: Two or more colors to draw the line with a vertical gradient. The first color is at the bottom of the chart, the last at the top.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Any CSS color, for example #00c6ff or purple.

property.caption: Opacity
property.description: Opacity of the line, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (solid).

property.caption: Width (px)
property.description: Set an explicit width for the SVG. Leave at 0 to fill the width of the parent container.

property.caption: Height (px)
property.description: Set an explicit height for the SVG. Leave at 0 to keep a 1:4 aspect ratio with the width. In most cases it is enough to control the size of the parent container.

property.caption: Padding
property.description: Space around the line, so very thick lines are not cropped at the edges of the SVG.

property.caption: Enable
property.description: Let the line draw itself when it appears.

property.caption: Duration (ms)
property.description: How long the auto draw animation takes.

property.caption: Easing
property.description: Any CSS transition timing function, for example linear, ease, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out or cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1).

property.caption: Redraw on data change
property.description: Play the auto draw animation again every time the data changes, for example after a refresh.

property.caption: Stroke width
property.description: The thickness of the line.

property.caption: Line cap
property.description: The shape of the two ends of the line.

property.caption: Line join
property.description: The shape of the corners where line segments meet (visible when smoothing is off).

property.caption: Dash pattern
property.description: Draw a dashed line, for example "4 4" or "1 6". Leave empty for a solid line. Do not combine with auto draw, which uses the dash pattern for its animation.

property.caption: Smooth
property.description: Round out the peaks so the line has no jagged edges.

property.caption: Radius
property.description: The amount of curve around each point. 0 means no smoothing; a very large number such as 10000 makes each peak as round as possible.

property.caption: Description
property.description: Text read by screen readers, for example "Revenue over the last 12 months, trending up". Leave empty to hide the chart from screen readers.
